display_long_description:
**Steal a Sigmon** is the stealing game built for VR. Buy Sigmons, stack up cash every second, then sneak into other players' bases and steal theirs with your own two hands!

Buy Sigmons off the conveyor and carry them home to your base.

[media]

Steal from other players, and lock your base before they steal from you!

[media]

Collect 60+ Sigmons, from Commons to Sigmon Gods and Secrets, with 10 mutations worth up to 10x the money.

[media]

Troll the lobby with 20+ weapons and prank items like black holes, poop grenades and giant hands.

[media]

Rebirth, fuse and trade your way to the top of the leaderboards.

[media]

Watch out for Admin Abuse: live events that hit every lobby at once, from meteor showers to a burning sun!

[media]

Dress up with 90+ cosmetics and show off your base with skins, effects and rooftop wardens.

[media]

We update all the time with seasonal maps, events, quests and a Season Pass. It's Christmas in Steal a Sigmon right now!

Join our Discord for rewards and events: discord.gg/stealasigmon
